PHOTO FILE - UNIT 13 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 156). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 13'.

KO'K RAMKALI XAT (rasmli bo'shliqlar):
'11th April, ......'
'Dear Heidi, How are you? I'm writing to invite you to my birthday party on 6th May at ...... [RASM: soat 7:00] at the Alpine Hotel. I hope you will be able to come.'
'We are going to have a ...... [RASM: odamlar bufet stolida] and my mother's going to ...... ...... ...... [RASM: shamli tort]. After I've blown ...... ...... ...... [RASM: shamli tort], my father is going to ...... ...... ...... [RASM: kostyumli erkak gapiryapti]. Then, we are going to ...... ...... ...... [RASM: bazm qalpoqli bolalar] and ...... [RASM: raqsga tushayotgan juftlik]. We were planning to have a ...... [RASM: sehrgar tayoqcha bilan] to perform some tricks, but then we decided not to.'
'I suppose you will come ...... ...... [RASM: sariq avtobus], so here are the directions from the bus stop. Walk past the church and ...... ...... [RASM: o'ngga burilish belgisi] into Grey Street. Walk to the end of the road and take the first turning on your ...... [RASM: chapga burilish belgisi] into Apple Street. The Alpine Hotel is about 50 metres down the street, opposite the post office.'
'I really hope you can make it. Write soon and let me know if you can come. Lots of love, Jane' [RASM: sharlar va sovg'a]

⚠ Bu 94-betdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon: 'Use the information in Ex. 11 to complete Jane's letter in the Photo File section.'

exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TARJIMASI (to'ldirilgan):

11-aprel
Aziz Heidi,
Qalaysan? Seni 6-may kuni SOAT
YETTIDA Alpine mehmonxonasidagi
tug'ilgan kun bazmimga taklif qilish
uchun yozyapman. Kela olasan deb umid
qilaman.

Biz BUFET qilmoqchimiz va onam TORT
PIShIRMOQChI. ShAMLARNI PUFLAB
O'ChIRGANIMDAN keyin otam NUTQ
SO'ZLAMOQChI. Keyin BAZM O'YINLARINI
O'YNAB, RAQSGA TUShMOQChIMIZ. Fokus
ko'rsatishi uchun SEHRGAR chaqirmoqchi
edik, lekin keyin bunday qilmaslikka
qaror qildik.

AVTOBUSDA kelasan deb o'ylayman,
shuning uchun bekatdan yo'l
ko'rsatmalar: Cherkov yonidan o'tib,
Grey ko'chasiga O'NGGA BURIL.
Yo'lning oxirigacha yur va birinchi
burilishda CHAP tomonga, Apple
ko'chasiga buril. Alpine mehmonxonasi
ko'cha bo'ylab 50 metrcha narida,
pochta qarshisida.

Kela olishingga chin dildan umid
qilaman. Tez orada yoz va kela
olishingni ayt.
Katta muhabbat bilan, Jane


JAVOBLAR:
  1 seven o'clock
  2 buffet
  3 bake a cake
  4 out the candles
  5 make a speech
  6 play party games
  7 dance
  8 magician
  9 by bus
  10 turn right
  11 left

  ⚠ 94-bet 11-mashq javoblari shu
  xatdan: bufet ✓, tort ✓, shamlar
  ✓, nutq ✓, o'yinlar ✓, raqs ✓;
  bouling ✗, sehrgar ✗ (bekor
  qilingan).


⚠ "I'M WRITING TO INVITE YOU":

  = seni taklif qilish uchun
  yozyapman.


⚠ 'AFTER I'VE BLOWN OUT':

  = puflab o'chirganimdan keyin
  (present perfect - kelajakdagi
  ketma-ketlik).


⚠ 'I SUPPOSE':

  = o'ylaymanki.


⚠ 'TO WALK PAST':

  = yonidan o'tmoq.


⚠ 'OPPOSITE':

  = qarshisida.


⚠ 'LET ME KNOW':

  = menga ayt, xabar ber.


⚠ 'LOTS OF LOVE':

  = katta muhabbat bilan (yaqin
  do'stga).

We are going to have a 2) [picture: people at a food table] ___
and my mother's going to 3) [picture: cake with candles] ___.
After I've blown 4) [picture: cake with candles] ___,
my father is going to 5) [picture: man in suit talking] ___.
Then, we are going to 6) [picture: kids in party hats] ___

patterns.formula: I'm writing to invite you to [tadbir] on [sana] at [vaqt] at [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: I'm writing to invite you to my birthday party on 6th May at seven o'clock at the Alpine Hotel.
patterns.exampleUz: Seni 6-may kuni soat yettida Alpine mehmonxonasidagi tug'ilgan kun bazmimga taklif qilish uchun yozyapman.

patterns.formula: After I've + V3, X is going to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: After I've blown out the candles, my father is going to make a speech.
patterns.exampleUz: Shamlarni puflab o'chirganimdan keyin otam nutq so'zlaydi.

patterns.formula: We were planning to + FE'L, but then we decided not to.
patterns.exampleEn: We were planning to have a magician, but then we decided not to.
patterns.exampleUz: Sehrgar chaqirmoqchi edik, lekin keyin bunday qilmaslikka qaror qildik.

patterns.formula: Walk past X and turn right into Y Street.
patterns.exampleEn: Walk past the church and turn right into Grey Street.
patterns.exampleUz: Cherkov yonidan o'tib, Grey ko'chasiga o'ngga buril.
